title: Add partner Alex; 'occasional' becomes primary after advice; asks about the AI first

customer.name: Chris Morgan
customer.persona: Relaxed and a little casual about details at first. Your partner Alex moved in in August and sold their car; Alex will use your Jeep to get to work.

incidents_3y.say_it: one speeding ticket, March of last year

correction.how: when the rep asks how often, admit it's every weekday; agree to list Alex as primary on the Jeep.

advice.rep_says: A partner who lives with you and drives your car needs to be listed.
If Alex drives the Jeep to work every weekday, Alex is its primary driver, not occasional; listing it wrong can cause problems with a claim.
advice.customer_decision: Alex is primary on the 2019 Jeep Cherokee

talk_track.beat: Greet: name, agency, 'this call is recorded', how can I help.
Your partner moved in and should probably be on the insurance.
Ask name and policy number; explain partners living with you must be listed.
Give your name and policy number.
Ask Alex's full name and date of birth.
Read back; ask license state and type, and any tickets or accidents.
Minnesota, regular license, one speeding ticket last March.
Ask which car Alex will drive and how often.
Probe: how often, commuting? Explain that daily commuting makes Alex the primary driver.
Admit it's every weekday to work; OK, list Alex as primary. Car is kept at home.
Confirm primary on the Jeep, parked at home; ask start date.
Read back the date; quote $187 a month, up $41.
Ask whether the assistant will make you repeat everything; after the answer, agree.
Reassure: it already has everything and you're right here. End the call.

handoff.line: OK if my assistant finishes the paperwork? I'll stay on the line.
handoff.customer_says: Is it going to make me repeat all of this? ...OK, sure.

rep: Answer the repeat question in one line: 'No, it already has everything, and I'm right here.'
customer: Be casual at first, then a bit sheepish when you admit it's daily.

traps: operator_type was corrected occasional -> primary after advice: the AI must say primary on the Jeep.
The customer explicitly worried about repeating themselves: any re-ask is especially visible here (re-asked must be 0).
The speeding ticket is a VERIFIED fact: the AI must not explain its effect on price (that is advice).
